t: A low power chip with a built in brain for tiny vision and sound AI.
steps: Buy the MAX78000FTHR Feather board from DigiKey or Newark for about 34 US dollars.
Plug it into your computer with a micro USB cable and try the spoken number demo.
Update the onboard debugger firmware with the steps in the ADI Feather guide.
Install the free ADI MSDK and the VS Code editor.
Build and flash a simple example from the MSDK.
Run the keyword spotting example from the MSDK next.
Try the ai8x training tools later to train your own model in PyTorch.
meta: Open Board. From $33.15. A few stores.
